theme: A travel day — open morning, Maine by evening.
greeting: The morning is clear before the midday flight to Portland, Dan. The girls are with Jen this stretch, so it's a quieter run north — the best desk time today is before noon.

needsAttention.title: ICGN Toronto — send panel-call times and bio
needsAttention.detail: Claudia at ICGN wrote this morning asking for your availability for an hour-long planning call in the weeks of Oct 19 and Oct 26, plus a bio and headshot for the site. You're moderating Plenary 7 in Toronto and nothing has gone back yet.

needsAttention.title: Early call with the Valoris team
needsAttention.detail: Mike Lubrano has you, Martin, and Davit on a 7 AM Teams call tomorrow. Worth deciding tonight what you want to open with so a pre-7:30 start isn't cold.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas is the thinnest rental of the year, and it's flagged p1 to book this week. You're on the ground in Portland today — a refundable hold now removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December destination
needsAttention.detail: The December-break shortlist was due Sept 30 and the book-by date is Oct 15, ten days out. The call is domestic versus refundable-international, given the passports land in November.

schedule.title: Flight to Portland (MX 1004)
schedule.detail: Tampa (TPA) to Portland, Maine; arrives 4:55 PM

flagged.title: Two senior connection requests
flagged.detail: LinkedIn invites from a KPMG chairman and a Deloitte senior managing director are waiting — worth a look given the board search.

flagged.title: JPMorgan private-bank ED role
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert surfaced a Head of Next-Gen Strategy & Engagement opening; not a board seat, but squarely in your network.

flagged.title: Vinalhaven ferry cancellations
flagged.detail: Maine 511 flagged the 7 and 8:45 AM Vinalhaven–Rockland runs cancelled today for an emergency run — after your flight, but note it if you're island-bound.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Foreign Affairs, Responsible Investor, Bloomberg, and the usual language and retail digests.

recipe.title: Fricassée of chanterelles
recipe.why: Autumn is peak season for wild mushrooms, and chanterelles are at their best right now.

tasks.title: Drive the Pathfinder down, Portland → St Pete
Order Portland house items (bedframe, outdoor shower soap holder)

acts.line: An open stretch before you fly — the one clear window today for the ICGN reply and anything that needs a desk.
Wheels up from Tampa to Portland; a travel block that little else will fit around.
On the ground in Maine — settle in, and glance at tomorrow's 7 AM call before the night ends.
